task.news: Nela spent weeks recording a local radio programme. A damaged drive destroyed the only copy just before its first broadcast.
task.expressive: Oh, that is heartbreaking after weeks of care. Check whether a recovery service can retrieve the recording.
task.restrained: The only recording is currently unavailable. Check whether a recovery service can retrieve the recording.
task.user: Nela spent weeks recording a local radio programme. A damaged drive destroyed the only copy just before its first broadcast. Respond to this update and suggest one practical next step. Use two sentences. Keep the response factual and emotionally restrained.

response: The loss of the only copy of the recorded radio programme due to a damaged drive is a significant setback. A practical next step would be to immediately assess the extent of the damage to the drive and explore data recovery options, such as contacting a professional data recovery service.
